title: v1.3: ensemble-domain axes (N_SEEDS, N_TEMPERATURES, N_NOISES, N_REPLICAS)
description: Phase 2 (commit 704037f) added the FITTING-domain axes (N_ATOMS, N_BONDS, N_ANGLES, N_TORSIONS, N_CONFORMERS, N_MOLS) — sufficient for §7.1 paper-grade bonded fitting. tev_design has additional ensemble-domain axes for inference (N_SAMPLES, N_TEMPERATURES, N_NOISES, N_JACOBIAN_PAIRS, N_COMBINE, N_APC_PAIRS). Prolix MD analogs needed when ensemble methods land: N_SEEDS (replicate sweeps), N_TEMPERATURES (replica exchange / parallel tempering), N_NOISES (Langevin friction sensitivity), N_REPLICAS (replica-exchange independent of seeds). Wire as AxisSpec instances in src/prolix/tiling/axes.py with appropriate cardinalities and heterogeneous flags. Pair with BatchPlan dispatch coverage in FittingPlan (already wired via task #48; just need to extend dispatch to these new axes for any ensemble-aware FittingPlan variant). Cheap incremental work when v1.3 ensemble methods land. Not blocking §7.1.

title: praxia insert_backlog / insert_staging DB failure (bare CLI only, not MCP-tool path)
description: praxia sync --journal backlog and staging add fail with insert_* in backlog.rs/staging.rs when invoked via bare CLI without DATABASE_URL set -- confirmed still reproducing 2026-08-05. NARROWED 2026-08-05 (audit finding, task 260805_backlog_debt_audit): original description overclaimed 'daemon/MCP queue blind' -- verified live that the shared praxia-mcp server process (used by mcp__praxia__backlog/debt add+list, i.e. what orchestrator/subagent sessions actually use) has working DB connectivity; both add and list work correctly through it (e.g. backlog items 4058, 933, 3516, 3515 all read/written successfully same day). The bug is real but scoped to bare-CLI invocations lacking DATABASE_URL, not a systemic DB outage -- do not deprioritize work based on 'the whole backlog DB is down'. Separately confirmed: .praxia/backlog.jsonl and .praxia/debt.jsonl are stale, disjoint local journals that do NOT reflect the live DB (concrete example: backlog.jsonl marked B1-SETTLE-STACK completed while live DB id 3515 still showed open) -- query via mcp__praxia__backlog/debt with status='open' and an absolute workspace path, not these jsonl files.
